acceptance_criteria.text: The Event Coordinator can record a withdrawal for a submitted event request that has not yet been approved or rejected.
A withdrawn request's status changes to Withdrawn.
A withdrawn request is distinguishable from Draft, Submitted, Approved and Rejected requests.
A withdrawn request is no longer available for review or further processing.
The Event Organiser can view that their request has been withdrawn.

test_cases.title: The assigned coordinator records the organiser's withdrawal of a request under review, and its status changes to Withdrawn
test_cases.preconditions: Run npm run fixtures:spm59 before this case. 'SPM59 Harbour Strategy Day' is Under review, organised by Rachel Ng and assigned to Daniel Tan. Logged in as daniel.tan@connectsphere.com / password123 (Event Coordinator). SPM-59-TC02 continues from this case, so go straight to it and run npm run fixtures:spm59 after it.
steps: Click 'All Events' in the sidebar and open 'SPM59 Harbour Strategy Day'
Click 'Record withdrawal'
Click 'Keep request' in the dialog
Click 'Record withdrawal' again
Click 'Record withdrawal' in the dialog
Click 'Review Queue' in the sidebar
test_cases.test_data: Event: SPM59 Harbour Strategy Day (Under review, coordinator Daniel Tan)
test_cases.expected_result:
Step 1: The event page shows the 'Under review' status badge, the 'This request is waiting for your review' alert and a 'Record withdrawal' button.
Step 2: A dialog 'Record this withdrawal?' reads 'Only do this when the organiser has asked to withdraw. SPM59 Harbour Strategy Day will be marked Withdrawn and can't be reopened. To go ahead later, the organiser submits a new request.' with the buttons 'Keep request' and 'Record withdrawal'.
Step 3: The dialog closes and the status badge still reads 'Under review'.
Step 5: A green alert reads 'The withdrawal has been recorded.' The status badge reads 'Withdrawn', Status in the Details card reads 'Withdrawn', and the 'Record withdrawal' button and the 'This request is waiting for your review' alert are gone.
Step 6: 'SPM59 Harbour Strategy Day' is not listed.

test_cases.title: The organiser sees that the request they asked to withdraw is now Withdrawn, on My Events and on the event itself
test_cases.preconditions: SPM-59-TC01 has just been run ('SPM59 Harbour Strategy Day' withdrawn by Daniel Tan) and the fixtures have NOT been reset since. Run npm run fixtures:spm59 after this case.
steps: Log out, then log in as rachel.ng@meridianfina.com / password123
Click 'My Events' in the sidebar
Click 'SPM59 Harbour Strategy Day' in the list
test_cases.test_data:
Organiser: Rachel Ng
Event: SPM59 Harbour Strategy Day, now Withdrawn
test_cases.expected_result:
Step 2: 'SPM59 Harbour Strategy Day' is listed under 'Submitted' with the 'Withdrawn' status badge.
Step 3: The event page shows the 'Withdrawn' status badge and Status 'Withdrawn' in the Details card, with Coordinator 'Daniel Tan'.

Click 'All Events' in the sidebar and open 'SPM59 Approved Seminar'
Click 'All Events' in the sidebar and open 'SPM59 Rejected Gala'
Click 'All Events' in the sidebar and open 'SPM59 Withdrawn Product Launch'
test_cases.test_data: Events: SPM59 Submitted Briefing (Submitted, no coordinator), SPM59 Approved Seminar (Approved), SPM59 Rejected Gala (Rejected), SPM59 Withdrawn Product Launch (Withdrawn)

test_cases.title: On My Events a withdrawn request has its own Withdrawn badge, distinct from Draft, Submitted, Approved and Rejected requests, and its own status filter
test_cases.preconditions: npm run fixtures:spm59 has been run. Rachel Ng organises 'SPM59 Draft Offsite' (Draft), 'SPM59 Submitted Briefing' (Submitted), 'SPM59 Approved Seminar' (Approved), 'SPM59 Rejected Gala' (Rejected) and 'SPM59 Withdrawn Product Launch' (Withdrawn). Logged in as rachel.ng@meridianfina.com / password123. Nothing is saved in this case.
steps: Click 'My Events' in the sidebar
Choose 'Withdrawn' in 'Filter by status'
test_cases.test_data:
Organiser: Rachel Ng
Events: SPM59 Draft Offsite, SPM59 Submitted Briefing, SPM59 Approved Seminar, SPM59 Rejected Gala, SPM59 Withdrawn Product Launch
test_cases.expected_result:
Step 1: 'SPM59 Draft Offsite' is listed under 'Drafts — not yet submitted'. Under 'Submitted', 'SPM59 Submitted Briefing' shows 'Submitted', 'SPM59 Approved Seminar' 'Approved', 'SPM59 Rejected Gala' 'Rejected' and 'SPM59 Withdrawn Product Launch' 'Withdrawn' - each its own badge.
Step 2: 'SPM59 Withdrawn Product Launch' is listed and every row shows 'Withdrawn'. None of the other four SPM59 events is listed.

test_cases.title: A withdrawn request can no longer be reviewed, booked, equipped or reassigned
test_cases.preconditions: npm run fixtures:spm59 has been run. 'SPM59 Withdrawn Product Launch' was withdrawn while Under review; it is assigned to Daniel Tan. Logged in as daniel.tan@connectsphere.com / password123. Nothing is saved in this case.
steps: Click 'Review Queue' in the sidebar
Click 'All Events' in the sidebar and open 'SPM59 Withdrawn Product Launch'
Note the event's reference (EVT-…) shown beside its status badge
Type /events/<reference from step 3>/review after the site address in the browser address bar (e.g. http://localhost:3000/events/<reference>/review) and press Enter
Click the 'Venue' tab
Click the event's 'Equipment' tab (not 'Equipment' in the sidebar)
Log out, then log in as grace.lim@connectsphere.com / password123 (Ops Manager)
Click 'All Events' in the sidebar and open 'SPM59 Withdrawn Product Launch'
test_cases.test_data: Event: SPM59 Withdrawn Product Launch (Withdrawn, coordinator Daniel Tan)
test_cases.expected_result:
Step 1: 'SPM59 Withdrawn Product Launch' is not listed.
Step 2: The event page shows 'Withdrawn', with no 'This request is waiting for your review' alert and no 'Review request', 'Record withdrawal' or 'Edit event information' button.
Step 4: The 'Review request' page does not stay open: the browser goes straight back to the event page, which shows 'Withdrawn'.
Step 5: The Venue tab reads 'A venue cannot be requested for a completed, cancelled, rejected or withdrawn event.' and offers no 'Request booking'.
Step 6: The Equipment tab reads 'This event is withdrawn — equipment requirements can no longer be changed.' and has no 'Add equipment' form.
Step 8: The event page shows 'Withdrawn' and no 'Change coordinator' card.

open_questions: RESOLVED 2026-10-22: AC1's "a submitted event request that has not yet been approved or rejected" is read as Under review, per customer clarification #103 ("withdraw a submitted event request while it is under review. The Event Coordinator will process and record the withdrawal"). A request that is Submitted has no coordinator yet - the Ops Manager's assignment is what moves it to Under review - so there is nobody to record it; SPM-59-TC03 checks it is not offered there.

RESOLVED 2026-10-22: the withdrawal action itself was built with SPM-27 (status rules, `canWithdrawEvent()`) and SPM-34 (the 'Record withdrawal' button and dialog). SPM-59 adds no new screen: these cases check that build against SPM-59's ACs, and the automated tests tagged [SPM-59] cover AC3 to AC5, which had none.

DECIDED 2026-10-22: the Venue tab's refusal for a closed event now names withdrawal too - 'A venue cannot be requested for a completed, cancelled, rejected or withdrawn event.' (was '... completed, cancelled or rejected event.', wrong for a withdrawn one).

DECIDED 2026-10-22: no reason is recorded with a withdrawal, and the organiser learns of it from the status (badge and Details), as for any other status change. #103 asks only that the coordinator record it and that it stay distinguishable. Telling the organiser by notification is Receive Event Notifications (SPM-53).

DECIDED 2026-10-22: a withdrawn request stays on My Events under 'Submitted' with its 'Withdrawn' badge, like the other non-draft statuses, and is not shown in any Dashboard section. Nothing in the story asks for a Dashboard section of its own.
